backend/main.mo: Main actor defining user profiles, books, preferences, and sell requests with authorization checks; includes mixins for authorization and storage, and runs migration on upgrade.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that adds a 'genre' field (defaulting to 'Unknown') to existing Book and SellRequest records when upgrading from old schema to new schema.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four debugging and UI improvement tasks for BookCatalog and SampleBooks components, including console logging, image mapping fixes, error boundaries, and catalog rendering verification.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files describing components, hooks, and styling with emphasis on caramel/cashmere color scheme, debug logging additions, and removed unimplemented backend features.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind layers defining OKLCH-based color variables for light and dark themes using neutral grayscale values.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with page title 'Kitabi Keeda' and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component with hero section, search bar, featured books, book catalog, sell book modal, and authentication-based profile setup flow.
frontend/src/components/AddBookForm.tsx: Admin-only component displaying an alert that the add book feature is unavailable due to missing backend implementation.
frontend/src/components/BookCard.tsx: Book card component displaying cover image with error handling/fallback, title, author, and price with hover effects.
frontend/src/components/BookCatalog.tsx: Displays a grid of books from the catalog with search filtering, loading states, and error handling. Maps book titles to local image assets and includes extensive debug logging for troubleshooting book data and image mappings.
frontend/src/components/CameraCapture.ts: Provides camera functionality for capturing photos with support for switching between front/back cameras. Handles camera permissions, errors, and converts captured images to ExternalBlob format for upload.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with brand information, contact details, social media links, and copyright notice. Includes a caffeine.ai attribution link with UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper component that structures the page with Navigation header, main content area, and Footer. Applies cream background color to the entire page.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button that toggles between login and logout states using Internet Identity. Handles authentication flow, query cache clearing on logout, and displays loading states.
frontend/src/components/MenuDropdown.tsx: Dropdown menu component with Settings, Personalization, and Browse Catalog options. Uses a custom menu icon image and styled with the app's color scheme.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Sticky header navigation with logo, menu dropdown, navigation links, and login button. Includes responsive mobile menu and decorative leafy background pattern.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts new users to enter their name during initial profile setup. Prevents closing until name is submitted and uses the saveCallerUserProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/SampleBooks.tsx: Displays a grid of sample books from the backend catalog, mapping book titles to local cover images. Includes extensive debug logging to track data flow and image mappings.
frontend/src/components/SearchBar.tsx: Search input component with voice search integration and clear button. Provides a rounded search bar with icons for search, voice input, and clearing text.
frontend/src/components/SellBookForm.tsx: Placeholder form component that displays a warning alert indicating the sell book feature is not yet implemented in the backend. Shows a disabled submit button.
frontend/src/components/SellBookModal.ts: Dialog modal wrapper for the SellBookForm component. Provides a styled modal interface for the book selling feature.
frontend/src/components/VoiceSearchButto: Button component that toggles voice recognition for search input. Uses the useVoiceSearch hook and displays mic/mic-off icons with visual feedback during listening.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that manages the backend actor instance, handling authentication with Internet Identity and admin token initialization. Invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality. Creates and manages AuthClient with configurable options and delegation identity handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for backend data operations including user profiles, book catalog, and role/admin checks. Each hook depends on the actor from useActor and includes detailed logging.
frontend/src/hooks/useVoiceSearch.ts: Custom hook that wraps the Web Speech Recognition API for voice input. Manages recognition state, transcripts, and errors with support for both SpeechRecognition and webkitSpeechRecognition.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color palette using OKLCH color space, defining caramel/cashmere theme colors, botanical accents (leaf-green, forest-green), and utility classes for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, rendering the main App component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for parameters like admin tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based color system (caramel, cashmere, botanical colors), container settings, custom animations, and typography/container-queries plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata for 'Kitabi Keeda' second-hand bookstore website tracking architectural decisions, known issues (dark background, light buttons, books not displaying), and implemented features including authentication, search, catalog, and leafy design theme.
